title: Implement fixed-role recursive control for the selected BIT caller
body:
I compile the selected schedule from David Arias's PR2753 into finite macrocode and execute it with one active frame, permanent stream roles and shared numerical banks. Before each child I serialize the successor PC and parent state; after return I restore those roles and continue at that PC. I also erase the root's owned markers and templates. The source-level proof retains O_q(V_root)+F_q space and O_q(V(n+w)) local work on the pinned input/root-coupling domain.

The implementation covers node setup, remainder peel, source-bound residuals, private COPY/XOR, IDLE, bridge/exchange and recursive CALL/RETURN. I forbid new physical Tape/Arena construction during completed blocks and use explicit scratch leases. Production calls the retained selected coefficient and descriptor routines.

Evidence includes:

- A complete 9,216-bit recursive GL2(F2) program: 5,859 macros, 12 child calls/returns and 156 residuals, with the source recursive Invocation constructor disabled.
- A complete 31,104-bit four-family GL2(F3) program: 192 MOVE, 96 COPY and 384 IDLE residuals. Independent oracles check each private COPY before cancelling XORs, both intermediate sweeps and the final endpoint.
- Actual selected rank-42 coefficients and typed child descriptors, exact parent restoration, scratch ownership controls, a nonzero remainder peel and a two-digit atom swap.

I corrected the earlier parent-identity verifier gap reported by [starship-s](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18960884). I reproduced the 214 accepted wrong-parent boundaries, then added identity checks before deterministic projection on both paths, twelve wrong-parent controls and three generated-call binding controls. I retain the auditor's reported Linux timeout on the old logical replay as a limitation; current validation details and receipts appear in VALIDATION.md and RESULT.json.

All seven registered commands passed under Python 3.12.15/macOS arm64 after that correction, before the final upstream refresh. The recursive and four-family controller replays took 104.67 and 321.60 seconds. At submission I merged canonical main `c719a5e0b3a6760a6fdf5d5af82d6ff2399329e5` and retained exact compatibility pins for its sole selected-record change, a UTF-8 verifier hash. Normal/-O Frame and continuation checks passed with the new authentication controls. Fresh complete-run attempts timed out: first in continuation at 30 seconds (then passed alone in 48.08 seconds), then in macro_nested under an experimental 240-second allowance. I restored the original registered budget. The controller and payload oracles have no changes from the full pass; I claim no complete pass after the refresh, fresh Linux pass or hosted-CI pass. VALIDATION.md records both outcomes.

I have not materialized the astronomical selected GL64 instruction word or expanded the retained primitives into one microtransition table. The reduced fixtures use their stated small grammars; the selected junction check uses a controlled body. Stronger H2 primitives, outer-wrapper composition and supplier admission remain separate. I make no exponent or frontier change.

I retain 97 byte-exact source exports and credit David Arias (PR2753), ywz65 (PR2635), my PR2769 codec and their predecessor notices. I used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; I claim no independent human or proof-assistant verification.

[Canonical scope and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18958887).

Reproduce the seven registered Python 3.12 suites:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-bit-physical-caller
```
